name: starbirth-draws-into-memory-and-summons-astral-shard
notes: Starbirth (qxu89i1mrk): draws the top card into memory and summons an Astral Shard token. Pre-fix playing it did nothing.

rulesClauses: Draw a card into your memory. Then summon an Astral Shard token.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated opening body for Starbirth was registered ONLY in $activateCardAbilities, a table nothing dispatches (an action's effect lives in $cardActivatedAbilities): playing the card paid its cost and resolved with no effect (no draw into memory, no Astral Shard). Live registrations of the same bodies in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php.
